summary: Add __eq__ and __hash__ methods for Todo class to enable comparison by id and set operations
acceptance_criteria_met: Todo(id=1, text='a') == Todo(id=1, text='b') returns True (same id equals)
Todo(id=1, text='a') != Todo(id=2, text='a') returns True (different id not equals)
hash(Todo(id=1, text='a')) == hash(Todo(id=1, text='b')) returns True (same id same hash)
set([Todo(id=1), Todo(id=1)]) returns a single-element set
risks: None - the implementation is minimal and well-tested
